stem: The Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) vaccine is the only vaccine used to provide protection against the infectious bacterial disease tuberculosis (TB). Most countries of the world have a BCG vaccination programme.

parts.text:
There is evidence that the BCG vaccine has also provided protection against the disease leprosy.

Leprosy is caused by a bacterium that is closely related to the bacteria that cause TB.

Suggest why the BCG vaccine can also provide protection against leprosy.
